title: Decoding Strategies handout (LETRS, Moats & Tolman), shared at Sweetwater PL Nov 2026
scope: Full text of the one-page handout.
content:
Break it down. Sound it out. Read it!
1 Consonant between the vowels: Underline the vowels. When a word has 1 consonant in between the vowels, draw a line before the consonant. If the word doesn't make sense, draw a line after the consonant. Read each syllable. Read the whole word. robot: ro bot
2 Consonants between the vowels: When a word has 2 consonants in between the vowels, draw a line between the consonants. Keep vowel teams, blends, and digraphs together (ea, st, mp, ch, or ph). picnic: pic nic
More Than 2 Consonants between the Vowels: When a word has more than 2 consonants in between the vowels, draw a line between the consonants. Keep vowel teams, blends, and digraphs together. dolphin: dol phin
Smaller Steps = Stronger Readers!
